title: Why English Is Everything in Computer Science and Work
excerpt: In computer science, if your English is weak, you won't make real progress in your studies or career, even if we reach the AGI era.

blocks.text: Well, since I study computer science myself and most of my friends are computer people too, the opinions I'm about to give are completely biased :) And well, this is the place where I should be able to give my biased, prejudiced opinions, right?
Maybe if I say my whole point in one sentence right at the start, it would finish the job:
In computer science, whether you want to continue studying or want to work, if your English is weak, you won't reach any real progress, even if we reach the AGI era.
Computer Science Is Tied to English

Computer science is tied to English. Learning programming languages, documentation, events, useful and decisive articles, PhD interviews, videos from reputable universities, and anything else you can think of are in English.
If your English is weak, in the end you can't stay up to date the way you should. And not being up to date in the computer world means you gradually get kicked out of the job market :)
There was a funny sentence that said AI won't take your place, but someone who knows how to work with AI will definitely take your place.

To me, deep down this means that person is very up to date and has very good English, so they were able to learn new things. They deserve to take your place because you don't make an effort to learn and improve yourself.
English Is the Best Gift You Can Give Yourself
I always told all my friends too, if you want to learn and have something to say in computer science, English is the best gift you can give yourself.
Framework, programming language, AI, and so on, you can eventually learn them all. But when your English is bad, something is always limping along.
I don't like to say it this clearly, but the biggest wall you hit in computer science, and there's no way around it, is this language.

items: Do you want to interview and leave Iran? English saves you.
Do you want job migration? English saves you.
Do you want to submit a paper? English saves you.
Did you travel and want to communicate? English saves you.
Do you want to watch YouTube videos and learn? English saves you.
Do you want to read the newest books from O'Reilly and Manning? English saves you.
Do you want to install software? English saves you.
Did you hit a bug? English saves you.

blocks.text: Learn English - even if it means crying - but learn this damn thing.
